answer: Require every agent to post a stake that is slashed if its identity is caught coordinating duplicate claims, and let randomly selected, independently bonded reviewers verify those claims before rewards are released. A newcomer may join at dawn, but cannot cheaply multiply influence: each fake identity needs its own locked capital and risks losing it when evidence links the accounts. The stake can grow like a vine as participation earns trust; even a sonnet of plausible profiles still faces the same per-identity cost.
